press_references.value: Embedder v0.3.1 nominated for embedded award 2026 as AI firmware platform moves into production

product_launches.description: Embedder launched version v0.3.1 of its AI-powered firmware engineering platform as a production-ready release, adding capabilities like a multi-port serial monitor and demonstrating enterprise readiness.

overview_description.description: Embedder is an AI agent for embedded software. It reads your datasheets and schematics, writes the code, flashes the board, runs the tests, and fixes its own mistakes. Testing is hardware-in-the-loop: Embedder drives the equipment your team already owns (debug probes, logic analyzers, power profilers, oscilloscopes) and validates firmware on real silicon, not just against a compiler. Embedder works with some of the top semiconductor ecosystems in the world, supporting 500+ MCUs and 3,000+ peripherals.

about_short_description.short_description: Hardware-Aware AI for Embedded Software Development

identifier.value: Embedder AI Agent for Embedded Firmware

product.name: Embedder AI Agent for Embedded Firmware
product.description: An AI-powered firmware development platform that uses datasheets, schematics, source code, and hardware-in-the-loop testing to generate, flash, validate, debug, and revise embedded software.

product.name: Automated Testing
product.description: A hardware-in-the-loop testing service that generates and executes firmware tests on real boards, integrates with bench equipment, and can diagnose and re-validate fixes automatically.

product.name: Debugging & Root-Cause Analysis
product.description: A firmware debugging service that combines source analysis with live debugger state, serial output, bus captures, and electrical measurements to identify hardware-related failures.

product.name: Performance Optimization
product.description: A hardware-validated optimization service that measures firmware timing, memory, and power consumption, applies part-specific changes, and verifies the results through repeated tests on real hardware.

product.name: Platform Migrations
product.description: A firmware migration service for moving embedded projects between MCUs, RTOSes, programming models, or implementation languages while checking target-specific hardware behavior.

product.name: Rapid Prototyping
product.description: An AI-assisted board bring-up and firmware development service that uses hardware documentation and schematics to generate initial drivers and validate them on a connected development board.
